statement: Guides targeting GENE-X lower the INFLAMMATORY-SIGNATURE score relative to non-targeting guides within this CRISPRi screen in donor-1 macrophages.

assay.controls: non-targeting guides, same donors, same batch
assay.batches: two, each containing three donors and both conditions
assay.replicates: eight targeting and eight non-targeting guides in one screen

falsification_conditions: the donor-level difference is indistinguishable from label assignment under a within-donor permutation
the effect reverses in any donor with adequate cell recovery
a generic stress signature moves at least as much as the claimed signature
allowed_scope: this screen, this donor, these guides. Not a population claim.
